subject: Coord: Orbit Analytics — technical review & calendar (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: technical review after discovery

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — Alex/Orbit enjoyed the conversation and would like to proceed to a technical review with your solutions team. The goal is a 60-90 minute session where we walk through Redwood's serving architecture and validate fit for our compliance and latency requirements.

Attendees from our side: Priya Shah (Head of Data), myself (Alex Moreno), and one of our CloudOps engineers (cloudops@orbitanalytics.com). Key topics we'd like covered:
- VPC/private deployment options and network topology
- Data residency and KMS integration
- Model pinning/versioning and rollback policies
- Typical latency/QPS characteristics and tuning knobs (batching, KV cache)

Do you have availability next week? A pre-read (architecture diagram + short agenda) would be very helpful. I've attached our discovery notes for context.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (10KB)

Looking forward,
Alex Moreno
Director, Data Platforms
Orbit Analytics
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: technical review after discovery

Hi Alex — great to hear you want to move to an architecture review. Happy to run this with Karthik (our SE) and loop Ben for commercial context. Proposed slots (PT):

- Tue Jun 8, 9:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed Jun 9, 1:00–2:30 PM PT

If those don't work we can do Thu Jun 10, 9:00–10:30 AM PT (which is 12:00–1:30 PM ET).

I've attached a short agenda and a one-page architecture pre-read. If you can confirm attendees and any additional constraints (e.g., strict IP allowlist for VPN), we'll send a calendar invite. Also here's a Calendly link if you'd prefer to self-book: https://calendly.com/redwood/jasmine-tech-review

Attachments: Orbit_Technical_Review_Agenda.pdf (34KB)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orbitanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: technical review after discovery

Thanks, Jasmine — appreciate the options. Jun 8 is a hard conflict for us. Can we aim for Thu Jun 10 or Fri Jun 11? Morning ET is ideal (10–11am ET or 11–12pm ET). We'll likely have one of our procurement/security folks join the first 15 minutes for compliance scoping, then hand off to CloudOps and Data.

Also: can you include any network ACL/VPN guidance in the pre-read? Our CloudOps engineer will want specifics (port ranges, proxy behavior, outbound connections).

—Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Data, Orbit Analytics
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: technical review after discovery

Hi Priya / Alex — Karthik here (Solutions Engineer). Jun 10 at 12:00 PM ET works for our team (that's 9:00 AM PT). I'll lead the architecture walkthrough and we can allocate 15–20 minutes at the start for procurement/security questions.

I attached a skeleton network diagram and a short checklist we typically share for VPC/private deployments. To make the session concrete, can you confirm target P95 latency for inference (ms) and expected sustained QPS per tenant? Also: are you planning multi-region failover or single-region initially?

Attachments: network-topology.png (128KB)

Thanks — we'll follow up with a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and a short set of pre-read links.

—Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orbitanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orbitanalytics.com>, cloudops@orbitanalytics.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: technical review after discovery

Thanks Karthik & Jasmine — Jun 10 at 12:00 PM ET / 9:00 AM PT works for us.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Target P95 latency: 250ms for small prompt completions; 500ms acceptable for larger multimodal requests.
- Expected sustained QPS: starting with 15–25 QPS, spiky to ~80 QPS during peak jobs.
- Single-region initially (US-WEST), plan to evaluate multi-region later.

We've accepted the calendar invite and will send our CloudOps engineer an allowlist request if there are any unusual ports. Looking forward to the session — please include the pre-read Drive folder and any short runbook we can share with procurement.

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics

Best,
Alex Moreno
Director, Data Platforms
Orbit Analytics
